verdict.rationale: AMD's own ROCm documentation says it provides full-stack docs and recipes for deploying AI workloads with popular ROCm-enabled frameworks, and it lists dedicated vLLM and SGLang inference guides. That is first-party framework support on ROCm. However, the pack never names PyTorch or other training frameworks, and shows no MI355X-specific support matrix or official build listing. Missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX official builds, a published compatibility/support matrix covering MI355X, independent hands-on corroboration of framework installs.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, PyTorch and mainstream ML frameworks run on this GPU through officially documented builds and support matrices

citations.quote: Full-stack documentation and recipes to deploy AI workloads on AMD GPUs using popular ROCm-enabled frameworks.
ROCm is AMD’s open-source GPU computing platform: an end‑to‑end ecosystem of compilers, runtimes, and libraries for AI, HPC, and domain‑specific workloads.
